# Chee Leong

> Software engineer in Malaysia building developer tools, structured data, and technical communities.

I build developer tools and machine-readable data sets, and I help run a few technical communities in Malaysia. Most of what I publish takes a source document and turns it into data you can validate and reuse.


## Projects

- [Collager](https://cheeleong.dev/collager/): A client-side editor for turning batches of photos into collages. [Source](https://github.com/klrkdekira/collager)
- [Word Search Puzzle Generator](https://cheeleong.dev/word_search_puzzle/): A browser-based generator for creating printable word search puzzles from custom words and hints. [Source](https://github.com/klrkdekira/word_search_puzzle)
- [Troika! Character Generator](https://cheeleong.dev/troika-generator/): A static, browser-based character generator using live data from Troika! System JSON. [Source](https://github.com/klrkdekira/troika-generator)
- [Daggerheart System JSON](https://cheeleong.dev/daggerheart-system-json/): A source-faithful, machine-readable edition of the Daggerheart System Reference Document 2.0. [Source](https://github.com/klrkdekira/daggerheart-system-json)
- [Graph20](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/): Machine-readable reference data for the D&D 5.2.1 System Reference Document, with source-level provenance. [Source](https://github.com/klrkdekira/graph20)
- [Blades in the Dark System JSON](https://cheeleong.dev/fitd-system-json/): A source-faithful, machine-readable edition of the Blades in the Dark System Reference Document. [Source](https://github.com/klrkdekira/fitd-system-json)
- [Basic Roleplaying System JSON](https://cheeleong.dev/brp-system-json/): A source-faithful, machine-readable edition of Chaosium's Basic Roleplaying System Reference Document. [Source](https://github.com/klrkdekira/brp-system-json)
- [Troika! System JSON](https://cheeleong.dev/troika-system-json/): Machine-readable JSON, JSON-LD, and validation schemas for the Troika! tabletop RPG System Reference Document. [Source](https://github.com/klrkdekira/troika-system-json)
- [Worlds Without Number System JSON](https://cheeleong.dev/wwn-system-json/): JSON schemas and data objects for Worlds Without Number based on the official System Reference Document (SRD). [Source](https://github.com/klrkdekira/wwn-system-json)
- [Data Parlimen](https://cheeleong.dev/data-parlimen/): A published corpus of Malaysian Parliament bills as a semantic knowledge graph on stable FRBR identifiers. [Source](https://github.com/klrkdekira/data-parlimen)
- BillWatcherNext: A provenance-first, read-only index of Malaysian Parliament bills. [Source](https://github.com/klrkdekira/BillWatcherNext)
